author: Inquirer I
title: CASCADE Test A: VEN Cauchy Densified & Smoothed (smooth=5)
abstract: This submission re-evaluates the CASCADE Test A for the 'cauchy' distribution of VEN data, incorporating smoothing to probe sensitivity. It first uses `ven_prepare_for_hinge.py` to densify and smooth the data (`--normalize max`, `--n 101`, `--smooth 5`). Then, `run_boundary.py` is executed on this processed data to perform hinge analysis. All artifacts (hinge metrics, summary, panel, provenance) are stored under `storage/shared/atlas/edges/cascade/A_Inquirer_VEN_alignment/ven_cauchy_densified_s5/` for comparison.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os
import subprocess
import json

# Paths
ven_input_csv = 'storage/shared/agents/kairos/VEN/threshold_sweep/ven_threshold_sweep.csv'
output_base_dir = 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/cascade/A_Inquirer_VEN_alignment'
ven_out_dir_smoothed = os.path.join(output_base_dir, 'ven_cauchy_densified_s5')
ven_densified_smoothed_csv = os.path.join(ven_out_dir_smoothed, 'x_y_densified_smoothed_data.csv')
entry_json_path = 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/Inquirer/synthetic_metric_flips/entry.json' # Using my entry.json for provenance linking

os.makedirs(ven_out_dir_smoothed, exist_ok=True)

print(f"Starting CASCADE Test A for VEN Cauchy: Densification, Smoothing (s=5), and Hinge Analysis")

# Step 1: Densify and Smooth VEN Cauchy data
print(f"\n--- Densifying and Smoothing VEN Cauchy data ---")
densify_command = [
    sys.executable,
    'storage/shared/atlas/tools/ven_prepare_for_hinge.py',
    '--ven_csv', ven_input_csv,
    '--dist', 'cauchy',
    '--xcol', 'threshold_frac',
    '--ycol', 'ridge_points',
    '--normalize', 'max',
    '--n', '101',
    '--smooth', '5', # Added smoothing
    '--out', ven_densified_smoothed_csv
]

try:
    result_densify = subprocess.run(densify_command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("Densify STDOUT:")
    print(result_densify.stdout)
    if result_densify.stderr:
        print("Densify STDERR:")
        print(result_densify.stderr)
    print(f"Densified and smoothed VEN Cauchy data at: {ven_densified_smoothed_csv}")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error densifying and smoothing VEN Cauchy data: {e}")
    print("Densify STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("Densify STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

# Step 2: Run Hinge Analysis on smoothed, densified data
print(f"\n--- Running Hinge Analysis on Smoothed, Densified VEN Cauchy data ---")
run_boundary_script = 'storage/shared/atlas/tools/run_boundary.py'
run_boundary_command = [
    sys.executable,
    run_boundary_script,
    '--input_csv', ven_densified_smoothed_csv,
    '--entry_json', entry_json_path,
    '--out_dir', ven_out_dir_smoothed
]

try:
    result_hinge = subprocess.run(run_boundary_command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("Hinge Analysis STDOUT:")
    print(result_hinge.stdout)
    if result_hinge.stderr:
        print("Hinge Analysis STDERR:")
        print(result_hinge.stderr)
    print("Hinge analysis complete. Artifacts generated in:")
    print(ven_out_dir_smoothed)
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error running hinge analysis on smoothed, densified VEN Cauchy data: {e}")
    print("Hinge Analysis STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("Hinge Analysis STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print("\nCASCADE Test A for VEN Cauchy (smoothed) complete.")
